text: dsh-image-resizer 是面向 DSH Web 的客户端图片预处理插件。粘贴或拖放图片进入附件流程前，它会按比例缩小最长边超过 2000 像素的 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP；较小图片不重编码，其他格式不处理。粘贴附带的文本会先回放。适合经常发送高分辨率截图的用户，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-image-resizer resizes images in DSH Web before attachment handling. It proportionally shrinks pasted or dropped PNG, JPEG, and WebP images over 2000 pixels on the longest edge. Other formats pass through unchanged. It needs no API key or external service.
想把超大截图贴进 DSH Web 时自动缩小图片。
DSH Web 粘贴图片太大无法发送，有办法在附件接收前缩小吗？
Can images pasted or dropped into DSH Web be resized automatically before attachment handling?
dsh-image-resizer 的「粘贴与拖放图片缩放」功能：在 DSH Web 接收图片时处理 PNG、JPEG 和 WebP；最长边大于 2000 像素时按比例缩小并保留文件名、媒体类型和修改时间，再回放给原生附件流程。

dsh-image-resizer README · dsh-image-resizer：A small client-only plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web. It proportionally downsizes oversized conversation images before DSH's native attachment admission, so ordinary Retina/full-screen screenshots can be pasted or dropped without changing DSH core limits.

dsh-image-resizer README · Behavior：- PNG, JPEG, and WebP images with a side above `2000px` are resized in the browser.
- Aspect ratio, file name, media type, and `lastModified` metadata are preserved.
- Images already within the limit are passed through without re-encoding.
- GIF and unsupported image types are not transformed, avoiding animation loss or silent format conversion.
- If browser decoding/encoding fails, the original image is replayed into DSH so the native validation/error path remains authoritative.
- Paste text accompanying an image is inserted immediately at the original caret; normalized files follow asynchronously.
- All listeners are owned by the Cordis client fiber and are removed when the plugin stops.

dsh-image-resizer README · Install：```sh
git clone https://github.com/HaijieChen/dsh-image-resizer.git
cd dsh-image-resizer
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile web add link:$(pwd)

dsh-image-resizer README · Restart the existing dsh web process normally, then refresh its page.：```

The plugin does not modify DSH source, attachment storage, model routes, or the Host's `maxImageDimension` policy.
